<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b>2019 EQUITY INCENTIVE PLAN</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:center;margin:0pt;"><b>AUSTRALIAN SUB-PLAN</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 16pt;">The following terms and conditions (the &#8220;<b><i>Australian Sub-Plan</i></b>&#8221;) shall apply to the award of Options granted to Participants under the 2019 Equity Incentive Plan (the &#8220;<b><i>Plan</i></b>&#8221;) of Imricor Medical Systems, Inc. (the "<b><i>Company</i></b>") who are resident in Australia. This Australian Sub-Plan has been adopted by the Board in accordance with Sections 3.2(i) and 3.4 of the Plan and may be amended, suspended or terminated by the Board in accordance with Section&nbsp;3.2(f) of the Plan. In the event of a conflict, whether explicit or implied, between the provisions of the Plan and the Australian Sub&#8209;Plan, the latter shall govern and prevail.</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&nbsp;</p>
